mapper.sql: select request_id, user_id, user_name, original_level, request_level, request_reason, status, is_temp, request_time, approve_by, approve_time, approve_note, use_time, rollback_time, create_time, update_time from permission_request
mapper.select: where status = '1' and is_temp = 1 and approve_time is not null and approve_time < #{beforeTime} order by request_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into permission_request ( user_id, user_name, original_level, request_level, request_reason, status, is_temp, request_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{userId}, #{userName}, #{originalLevel}, #{requestLevel}, #{requestReason}, #{status}, #{isTemp}, #{requestTime}, now(), now() )
